282854202.description:
Selenite Crystal Wand Lot - 7 Pieces
Natural Mineral Specimens, Metaphysical & Display Collection
Raw Satin Spar Gypsum
This collection features seven individual sticks of natural selenite (fibrous satin spar gypsum), known for its luminous, chatoyant white appearance and linear crystalline striations. Prized by mineral collectors and metaphysical practitioners alike, selenite is widely utilized for meditation, energy cleansing, altar display, or specimen study. Each piece exhibits distinct natural textures, raw cleavage faces, and unique cross-sectional geometry.
Items Included:
7 individual raw selenite crystal sticks/wands with natural striations and varied triangular and rectangular profiles
Varied natural terminations, rough cleavage ends, and fibrous linear structures
Natural fibrous gypsum mineral composition in translucent to opaque white tones
Condition:
Natural rough mineral specimens in good structural condition. Characteristic natural flaking, surface dust, uneven cleavage ends, and minor mineral matrix inclusions are present, which are typical of raw satin spar selenite. No artificial repairs or adhesives observed.
